interpretation: Molar dietary exposure may be compared when source, food form and intake model are aligned.
major_caveat: Absorption and matrix effects remain separate; missing intake is not zero.

interpretation: Counts evidence depth under the class-specific eligibility rule.
major_caveat: Equal counts do not imply equal protocol quality or biological importance.

interpretation: Compares confidence labels generated from independent evidence depth and heterogeneity.
major_caveat: Confidence rules must remain harmonized; it does not compare antioxidant magnitude.

interpretation: Compares evidence hierarchy when the same human-evidence rubric is applied.
major_caveat: PK exposure must not be interpreted as efficacy.

interpretation: Compares the type of target evidence under the shared target hierarchy.
major_caveat: Only T1/T2 are direct-target layers; tier is not target potency.

interpretation: Compares the presence and evidence grade of dose-window or prooxidant concerns.
major_caveat: Risk depends on dose, matrix, metal environment and population.

interpretation: Shows relative position inside each class-specific eligible universe.
major_caveat: Equal percentiles do not mean equal antioxidant magnitude and cannot create a global rank.

interpretation: Shows which redox domains have evidence without adding them into one score.
major_caveat: Different domains represent different constructs and evidence depths.

interpretation: Supports comparison of exposure patterns and metabolite relevance.
major_caveat: Cmax, AUC, conjugation and tissue exposure are not one common scalar.

interpretation: Compares feasibility after a common rubric is applied.
major_caveat: Depends on model, analytical platform, solubility and assay objective.

interpretation: Shows robustness of the class-specific estimate.
major_caveat: Stability is distinct from effect magnitude and confidence.

valid_unit_or_scale: mol TE/mol within compatible H-ORAC-FL arm
interpretation: May compare compounds only under compatible H-ORAC-FL conditions.
major_caveat: Cannot be assumed commensurate with L-ORAC or other class-specific constructs; historical protocols remain non-identical.

valid_unit_or_scale: mol TE/mol within validated L-ORAC arm
interpretation: Potential within-arm metric for lipophilic compounds.
major_caveat: H- and L-ORAC are not automatically on one scale.

interpretation: Relevant to carotenoids under a separately frozen construct.
major_caveat: Different physical/chemical quenching systems and units prevent direct mixing with H-ORAC.

interpretation: Represents regulatory evidence rather than direct chemical capacity.
major_caveat: Pathway activation, expression and causal dependence must remain separated.

interpretation: Represents enzyme cofactor or redox-context relevance.
major_caveat: Elements are not structurally defined antioxidant small molecules and can become prooxidant depending on context.
